purpose: Run short oral SAP Lead practice from Core 12 boundary drills using the same seven-dimension scoring model as the rest of the assessment Lab.

default_session.selection: shuffle without replacement from the boundary-drill set
answer_sequence: State the expected business outcome and current symptom.
Name the two or three ownership domains involved.
Trace the shortest evidence path to the first divergence.
Explain why the downstream symptom may be owned upstream.
Define proof of cause and proof of end-to-end completion.
Add one trade-off or condition that would change the diagnosis or design.

reveal_policy.boundary_question: hidden until the learner chooses to reveal it
reveal_policy.expected_reasoning: hidden until the learner finishes the oral answer

scoring.rule: Score demonstrated reasoning, ownership, evidence, and trade-offs. Do not reward the number of SAP terms mentioned.

review_handoff.trigger: after at least one completed round
review_handoff.aggregation: average each scoring dimension across completed Board rounds in the current browser-memory session
review_handoff.selection: rank dimensions by lowest average score, then show up to two weakest dimensions
review_handoff.route_rule: use the first focused route from review-map.json for each selected weak dimension
review_handoff.rule: The handoff is a temporary study recommendation. It does not modify persistent assessment history or calibration.

session_boundary: Board Mode is browser-only oral practice. It does not publish cases, approve candidates, change factual-review state, or write assessment history automatically.
future_history_rule: If Board Mode is later connected to persistent assessment history, it must write through the existing attempt schema instead of creating a second history format.
